text:
mira: morning everyone 44b first day checklist hiccup: Okta SSO prompted me to re-enroll device trust but the flow errors with 'YubiKey already registered to another account'. also the 'Engineering Welcome' Drive link isn't in My Drive, and 1Password invite says 'pending seat'. who should i bug?

it-support: hey @mira welcome! that yubikey error usually means the key was registered under a previous alias (sometimes our temp provisioning email). can you check if you have any old Redw0od or redwood.dev accounts in your browser passkeys/webauthn list?
mira: good call  i see an entry for mira.temp@redwood.ai in chrome://settings/passwords -> Passkeys. should i delete it?
security: quick note: don't paste attestation blobs here. deleting the old passkey is OK if you control the device. alternatively we can rebind the key server-side to your primary account.
mira: deleted the old passkey entry and retried the Okta flow, now it progresses but stalls at 'SCIM sync pending' message.
people-ops: @mira i see your hire record used a temp alias earlier that queued in SCIM. i've updated the primary to mira@redwood.ai and requeued the SCIM push for SaaS provisioning (Drive + 1Password).
onboard-bot: Ticket #ONB-7019 created for identity-rebind. assignee=it-support. ETA 45m.
sam: for the Drive: you can often find items under drive.google.com/drive/shared-with-me. Search "Engineering Welcome Pack" and use Add shortcut to Drive if you see it. We also have a short one-click script in the onboarding doc to add core shortcuts.
mira: found the Drive in Shared with me and added a shortcut, thanks Sam.
it-support: SCIM push completed from our console; 1Password invite should be in your inbox shortly. Also try the Okta SSO flow again now that the SCIM sync finished.
mira: Okta device trust passed on retry! 1Password invite arrived and accepted. yubikey registration looks clean now. all set. :tada:
people-ops: welcome aboard @mira! DM us if anything else pops up and we'll run through the checklist (payroll, benefits links, seating)
mira: thanks everyone  excited to start pairing.
